name: Link
summary: Navigates to another location or resource.

useWhen: Navigating to another location, such as a page, a section, or a file
avoidWhen: Triggering an immediate action; use Button

web.html.reason: Parked by Decision 0031: no responsible implementation until W1.0 restores @muxui/web.

behavior: Disabled links suppress navigation and remain perceivable
A Link without an href, or with an empty one, is disabled even when disabled is false.
A disabled Link renders as a span with the link role, not as an anchor.
onActivate runs when an enabled Link is activated, in addition to following href; it does not replace href.
A disabled Link does not call onActivate.
accessibility: Expose link role, destination, current state, and disabled state
